projects.title: Highbridge Park aerial mapping and 3D documentation
projects.limitations: SiteScan lists these output types. Positional and vertical accuracy and bare-earth terrain classification have not been independently assessed.

display_products.alt_text: A long, narrow orthomosaic shows paths and autumn tree canopy through Highbridge Park against a dark background.
display_products.caption: Highbridge Park survey orthomosaic, showing the mapped park corridor with the basemap off.
display_products.date_basis: Date shown in the SiteScan mission. The mission date does not establish the capture time of every source photograph.
display_products.label: Survey orthomosaic
display_products.uncertainty: Individual source-image capture times and independent positional accuracy were not verified. This view shows the mapped corridor, not complete park coverage.

display_products.alt_text: A textured 3D model of the Highbridge water tower with green roofs and stone walls, viewed obliquely against a black background.
display_products.caption: Textured reconstruction of the Highbridge water tower, viewed obliquely with the basemap off. Small gaps and edge fragments remain visible.
display_products.date_basis: Date shown in the SiteScan mission. The mission date does not establish the capture time of every source photograph.
display_products.label: Tower textured mesh
display_products.uncertainty: Individual source-image capture times and independent positional accuracy were not verified. Gaps, texture distortion and edge fragments remain in the reconstruction.

projects.display_note: Selected views show the orthomosaic and tower reconstruction; original datasets are not distributed here.
